run_reconstruction_completeness: run the CLI tool to measure reconstruction completeness across multiple 3D scene datasets using JSON metadata files
run_defect_analysis_rgb_depth: run the tool in rgb+depth mode to analyze mesh defects across Gibson, MP3D, and ScanNet datasets
run_defect_analysis_depth_only: run the tool in depth mode to evaluate depth map defects for a single dataset
run_defect_analysis_rgb_only: run the tool in rgb mode to evaluate RGB image defects for a single dataset
run_custom_defect_threshold: run the tool with a custom fraction threshold to tune defect detection sensitivity
